response.original_title: ((Complete Guide))How do i add a passenger on a Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: To add another Passenger to an existing Carnival Cruise reservation, +1-866-829-1280 (US) you must book a separate new state Passenger and call Carnival Cruise customer service at +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-1280 (UK) contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a Passenger to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new state Passenger online or via phone. You must call Carnival Cruises Customer Service at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent directly, as passenger additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.
